rows.known_text: no matter how much I want to escape
rows.target_text: どんなに逃げたくても

rows.known_text: next time no matter how much I want to do it
rows.target_text: 次にどんなにやりたくても

rows.known_text: every morning no matter how much I want to sit
rows.target_text: 毎朝どんなに座りたくても

rows.known_text: no matter how much I want to climb
rows.target_text: どんなに登りたくても

rows.known_text: no matter how much I want to do it I can't think it's easy
rows.target_text: どんなにやりたくても簡単だとは思えない

rows.known_text: no matter how much I wanted to escape I was told I had to be quiet
rows.target_text: どんなに逃げたくても静かにしなきゃいけないって言われてた

rows.known_text: no matter how much you want to climb it seems better to go home
rows.target_text: どんなに登りたくても帰ったほうがよさそう

rows.known_text: when we meet no matter how much I want to escape I have to be quiet
rows.target_text: 会うときどんなに逃げたくても静かにしなきゃいけない

rows.known_text: no matter how much I want to escape I don't want to show it
rows.target_text: どんなに逃げたくても見せたくない

rows.known_text: no matter how much I wanted to do it I wasn't able to keep going
rows.target_text: どんなにやりたくても続けられなかった

rows.known_text: in the old days no matter how much I wanted to escape I couldn't do it
rows.target_text: 昔はどんなに逃げたくてもできなかった
